# ephemeral.docker_swarm_tokens

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: ephemeral-resource. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Reads the worker and manager join tokens of the swarm the provider's Docker host manages, as ephemeral values that are never written to plan or state. Use it (Terraform 1.10+) instead of the `docker_swarm_tokens` data source when the tokens may only flow into write-only arguments (such as `docker_secret.data_wo`), provider blocks or other ephemeral resources. The host must be a manager.

Ephemeral resources need Terraform >= 1.10. Their values are never written to
plan or state; reference them only from ephemeral contexts (write-only
arguments, provider blocks, ephemeral variables, outputs and locals, other
ephemeral resources).

## Usage

```terraform
ephemeral "docker_swarm_tokens" "<name>" {
  # arguments below
}

# Reference ephemeral.docker_swarm_tokens.<name>.<attr> only from ephemeral contexts:
# write-only arguments, provider blocks, ephemeral variables/outputs/locals.
```

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | computed |  |  | Swarm cluster ID. |
| `manager` | `string` | computed |  | yes | Token that joins a node as a manager. |
| `worker` | `string` | computed |  | yes | Token that joins a node as a worker. |

## Example

```terraform
# Join tokens as ephemeral values (Terraform 1.10+): they are used during the
# run but never written to plan or state. Ephemeral values can only flow into
# write-only arguments, provider blocks and other ephemeral resources; here the
# worker token becomes a swarm secret a bootstrap service hands to new nodes.
ephemeral "docker_swarm_tokens" "current" {}

resource "docker_secret" "worker_join_token" {
  name            = "swarm-worker-join-token"
  data_wo         = base64encode(ephemeral.docker_swarm_tokens.current.worker)
  data_wo_version = 1
}
```
